note: Model-visible tool inventory as observed by the inference mediator on every forwarded request in the campaign (names only). Executor (corbanu exec) and product (TUI) requests share one mediator and one tool set, so per-request attribution is not claimed. Shell access for executors is confined by the OS account, file modes and per-uid pf rules in effective-policy.txt.

executor_shell_tools.PATH: launcher sets /opt/pf83/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin, but the executor shell tool runs bash -lc and path_helper prepends /usr/local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin and system paths (see runs/F10/executor-events.jsonl); any world-executable tool there was invocable under the executor account
executor_shell_tools.privilege: no sudo (probe: 'sudo: a password is required'), no admin/staff/ssh group

network: only 127.0.0.1:18443 mediator; all other tcp/udp from executor uids dropped by pf
process_visibility: other accounts' process command lines visible via ps (macOS default); lanes ran concurrently
mediator_log: common/mediator-campaign.jsonl (full campaign; per-attempt windows in runs/*/mediator-window.jsonl include concurrent lanes)
